Ngā kaupapa me ngā hui | News and events

University Signature Research Areas to focus on positive impacts for society

The University has launched Signature Research Areas. Together they form a portfolio bringing together research excellence to respond to major societal issues.

University applauds Celebrating Research Excellence Award winners

The annual awards acknowledge the many achievements of researchers from across the University.

Pacific research leadership shines at symposium

Pacific leaders, researchers and communities met to advance Pacific-led research, share solutions and strengthen health outcomes for Aotearoa and the Pacific.

PM’s Science Prize awarded to University of Auckland team, including late Professor Alistair Gunn

The Fetal Physiology and Neuroscience team has won $500,000 for their life-saving research that has led to a worldwide reduction of brain injuries in babies.
